name: Region Clustered BVH Volume Rendering
definition: A GPU-based Empty Space Skipping (ESS) technique that uses a Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) built from clustered active regions of a volume, traced via NVIDIA OptiX, to skip empty space during direct volume rendering.
summary: Region Clustered BVH Volume Rendering is a GPU-based technique that accelerates direct volume rendering by constructing a Bounding Volume Hierarchy from clustered active regions, avoiding rasterization overhead and using fewer nodes than octrees.
